title: noise-floor/1: the noise of an ion-counting trace with a floor of one ion
description: noise = max(mad_k x MAD, sd_weight x SD, one_ion x sqrt(max(lambda, 1))) over the background points (the stretch from..to without the peak window), lambda = mean background counts per point. With a peak window: its apex above the background median, its S/N on that noise and on the MAD alone, and the check of rule R1 (docs/studies/TP_SCREENING_RULES.md). Intensities in cps, times in minutes. The same bytes from mzlab-cli peak noise and mzlab-wasm noise_floor. Code: crates/mzlab-core/src/ionstat.rs, crates/mzlab-cli/src/peak_noise_cmd.rs.

one_ion.description: "auto" (the quantum of the trace), 0 (off) or the cps of one ion that was set.

from.description: Start of the stretch, min; null = the start of the trace.

to.description: End of the stretch, min; null = the end of the trace.

quantum.description: The smallest positive background value or step between distinct values (values within a relative 1e-6 of each other are one value: the rounding of summed f32 intensities is not a step), and the share of positive values within 0.02 of an integer multiple of it; accepted with at least 3 positive values, a support of 0.9 and a level (median positive value in quanta) of at most 100, since integer spacing alone is not evidence of ion counting. Null without positive values.

mad.description: mad_k x the median absolute deviation from the median.

one_ion.description: cps of one ion used; null when off or no quantum was accepted.

lambda.description: Mean background counts per point (mean / one_ion).

estimator.description: The term that gave the noise (one_ion: lambda <= 1; poisson: lambda > 1); ties go to the first of mad, sd, ion term.

height.description: Apex minus the background median, cps.

sn.description: height / noise; null when the noise is 0.

sn_mad.description: height / mad, the S/N a pure MAD gives; null when the MAD is 0.

status.description: pass: sn >= min_sn with an ion term; fail: below; warn: no ion term (off or no accepted quantum) or noise 0; n/a: no finite point in the peak window.

rule.description: The numbers behind the status, in words.

ions.description: Only with `peak noise --ions`: the second scale. The trace is measured again with one ion = one_ion_cps (1 / the factor), so noise_ions, S/N and the check are those of the ion scale; the cps members above are unchanged.

oneOf.description: The factor of ionscale::factor, ions = cps x ions_per_cps: scan_type, ions_per_cps, cps_per_ion, source (method|data), field, data_ions_per_cps, ratio, agree (within 5 %), missing.

ion_scale_choice.description: The log of the automatic choice: scan_type, scan_type_from, evidence.

one_ion_cps.description: cps of one ion at the factor.

oneOf.description: As the check above, at the ion scale: id noise_floor, status, value (sn_ions), threshold, rule.
